decision.attempt_accounting: This proposal is non-economic and consumes zero attempts; no identity is opened and no protected accounting or safety state is changed.
decision.breadth_policy: Select a variable-size set only after fresh broker-native screening; maximize non-economic structural diversity and independent event coverage, while excluding correlated duplicates and narrowing only with frontier-relative structural reasons.

Do not select a subgroup based on economic outcomes
Do not authorize live orders or an economic experiment envelope yet

prospective freeze of symbols, rules, costs, and evaluation horizon

need to verify broker-native data and EUR200 margin feasibility

next_research_state.next_action: Acquire or validate fresh authoritative Pepperstone-native symbol, cost, margin, and data-availability evidence for structurally diverse candidates spanning CARRY_TERM_STRUCTURE first and REGIME_CONTEXT_CONDITIONED second; then freeze the breadth only if all prerequisite gates pass.

objective.goal: Identify the highest-information legal research wave from the complete eligible broker-native frontier before authorizing any economic outcome.
objective.information_gain_rationale: All ten open mechanism families are considered against structural heterogeneity, event independence, data availability, and EUR200 survivability. Previously consumed identities and outcome-exposed C032 evidence are excluded. The next highest-value uncertainty is whether an unconsumed CARRY_TERM_STRUCTURE or REGIME_CONTEXT_CONDITIONED mechanism has sufficient Pepperstone-native breadth, independent events, executable costs, and margin feasibility; this is more informative than rerunning accepted or consumed identities.
